PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 general marking note; 4 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 5–7 transcript (never shown to students); 8–10 listening answers in the paper's order, the Fógra a hAon grid first (PDF 8), ending with the mark-total boxes on PDF 10; 11 composition marking (tariffs, the (i) Cumas Gaeilge / (ii) Beachtas definitions and their 40% : 60% ratio, the bracketed content note, the examiner's Nóta). The 2015 scheme prints no 40-mark table; 21 modified marking (SMM, naming the composition's 40-mark Cumas Gaeilge assessment, with no bands). PDF 12–21 are Paper 2 (its last Nóta tops PDF 21); 22–24 are blank.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate 3-mark criterion (20 questions; the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card. Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email and dó/di wording stay inside one response.

caveats: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6; every question 3 marks, “3 mharc × 4” / “3 mharc × 2” on PDF 4) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 4 in 2015; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t-eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; the 2015 scheme prints their answers first (PDF 8), each as “answer 3 mharc” in the grid's right column, with partial prices (“Ó na cairteacha 2 mharc”; “Ticéid 2 mharc chuig ceolchoirmeacha 1 mharc”). Each grid question is its own criterion (labelled Greille 1–4 in the app).

Comhrá a hAon An Dara Mír 2 prints its half-answer rule as text after the answer: “Leictreachas agus teas = 3 mharc Ceann amháin den dá rud (leictreachas nó teas) i gceart, bronn 2 mharc air”; the criterion allows 0, 2 and 3.

The 2015 composition marking prints no headed Tasc, Ábhar and Cumas Gaeilge sections and no 40-mark table: the tariff block (Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40) is the Tasc criterion's text; the bracketed note “[Ní mór ceangal cinnte a bheith idir … nach bhfuil ad rem.]” (no “leanúnach”, which the paper's Treoracha print) is the content guidance, lifted as the Ábhar criterion's text; the (i) Cumas Gaeilge and (ii) Beachtas definitions (“[(i) agus (ii) sa chóimheas 40% : 60%]”) and the examiner's Nóta go with Cumas Gaeilge. The modified-marking page (PDF 21) prints no 40-mark bands.
Paper prints “t-” with ASCII hyphens and “D’fhéach”, “m’fhón” with U+2019; B(i) ends on “…” and B(ii) on “...”; cards keep the paper's characters.
No 2015 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 15 cards are new.

Treoracha d’iarrthóirí
Ní mór do na hiarrthóirí cúram a dhéanamh de chruinneas na teanga. Caillfear marcanna má bhítear faillitheach ann. Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach a bheith ann idir an teideal a roghnaítear agus an t-ábhar a scríobhtar.

Scríobh giota leanúnach nó blag (leathleathanach nó mar sin) ar cheann amháin de na hábhair seo.
(i) Breithlá iontach a bhí agam.

guidance: Freagair do rogha dhá cheann de A, B, C, D anseo. I gcás A, B, C agus D (Dhá cheann le freagairt) Leathleathanach nó breis: Tasc = 2 mharc Ábhar = 8 marc = 50 marc x 2 Cumas Gaeilge = 40 marc = 100 marc

criteria.label: An tÁbhar
guidance: [Ní mór ceangal cinnte a bheith idir an teideal a roghnaítear agus an t-ábhar a scríobhtar. Gearrfar pionós ar iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta nach bhfuil ad rem.]

criteria.label: An Cumas Gaeilge
guidance: (i) Cumas Gaeilge = Fairsinge, saibhreas agus oiriúnacht Stór Gaeilge an iarrthóra (foclóir cuí, dul na Gaeilge, nathanna cainte agus frásaí oiriúnacha) (= 40%) agus (ii) Beachtas = Cruinneas maidir le húsáid phríomhghnéithe de cheart na Gaeilge (struchtúir/comhréir na teanga, aimsirí na mbriathra, séimhiú, urú, réamhfhocail, claoninsint...) (= 50%) agus litriú (= 10%) [(i) agus (ii) sa chóimheas 40% : 60%]

Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc a bhronntar as 2 (Tasc), an marc a bhronntar as 8 (Ábhar) agus an marc a bhronntar as 40 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint go soiléir ag bun na n-iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta.

cards.markingGuideNote: Whole 50-mark composition: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40. The 2015 scheme prints no 40-mark table and no 40-mark bands: Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its two printed aspects, (i) Cumas Gaeilge and (ii) Beachtas, in the ratio 40% : 60%, so the Cumas Gaeilge award can take any value from 0 to 40. The letter or email (C) and the dó/di wording are flexible forms inside one response, not separate routes. Scéim Mharcála Mhodhnaithe (scheme PDF 21): for eligible candidates, spelling and certain grammar features are not penalised in the 40-mark Cumas Gaeilge assessment; no bands are printed.

guidance: (i) Cumas Gaeilge = Fairsinge, saibhreas agus oiriúnacht Stór Gaeilge an iarrthóra (foclóir cuí, dul na Gaeilge, nathanna cainte agus frásaí oiriúnacha) (= 40%) agus (ii) Beachtas = Cruinneas maidir le húsáid phríomhghnéithe de cheart na Gaeilge (struchtúir/comhréir na teanga, aimsirí na mbriathra, séimhiú, urú, réamhfhocail, claoninsint...) (= 50%) agus litriú (= 10%) [(i) agus (ii) sa chóimheas 40% : 60%]

Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc a bhronntar as 2 (Tasc), an marc a bhronntar as 8 (Ábhar) agus an marc a bhronntar as 40 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint go soiléir ag bun na n-iarrachtaí ceapadóireachta.

cards.markingGuideNote: Whole 50-mark composition: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40. The 2015 scheme prints no 40-mark table and no 40-mark bands: Cumas Gaeilge is judged on its two printed aspects, (i) Cumas Gaeilge and (ii) Beachtas, in the ratio 40% : 60%, so the Cumas Gaeilge award can take any value from 0 to 40. The letter or email (C) and the dó/di wording are flexible forms inside one response, not separate routes. Scéim Mharcála Mhodhnaithe (scheme PDF 21): for eligible candidates, spelling and certain grammar features are not penalised in the 40-mark Cumas Gaeilge assessment; no bands are printed.
